headline: Apple Overtakes Nvidia as World's Most Valuable Company Amid Tech Selloff
summary: Apple surpassed Nvidia to become the world's most valuable company as Wall Street closed lower and the Nasdaq recorded its worst month in over a year. Investors engaged in massive tech sector selling amid concerns over massive spending and the sustainability of artificial intelligence.
why: Valuation shifts among mega-cap technology firms reflect broad investor sentiment shifts toward the entire technology sector and heavy AI capital expenditures, heavily influencing major equity indexes like the Nasdaq and S&P 500.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Composite
impacts.why: Heavy selling in mega-cap tech stocks drove the tech-heavy Nasdaq index down sharply.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Massive investor sell-offs in major technology stocks driven by valuation and AI spending concerns directly depressed the Nasdaq and altered the market capitalization rankings of top tech firms.
